pipeline: removeUnhelpfulBricks -> buildLearnerBrickIndex -> restore aliases/routes from same-name unfiltered families -> refineSingleUseFamilies
definition: One unique standard, regardless of how often the brick repeats inside it

supportRules.target: At least two distinct standards in the original target family; matching ordered root/core-quality structure has complete passages in at least two standards
supportRules.core: Tonic-relative root plus major/minor/dominant/diminished/half-diminished/augmented/suspended quality; extensions, explicit bass, rhythmic proportions and key contexts remain in full variants and weighted distance
supportRules.anchors: At least two ordered root/core-quality matches, anchored to sequence ends; for3+chords at least3anchors,80percent short-sequence and75percent long-sequence coverage
supportRules.twoChord: Both sequences exactly two chords, both ordered cores match, distance<=0.12; never merge a loose two-chord fragment
supportRules.ambiguity: Reject competing families within0.025 distance, regardless of popularity
supportRules.source: Every source variant must match one chosen target; unknown, clipped harmonic data, partial or unresolved occurrences cannot establish a fuzzy merge
supportRules.sourceLabels: Merged raw row labels remain unchanged and resolve through unioned aliases; unmatched one-standard labels are removed only at audited source positions
